fullContent:
Indukantham Kashayam – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Sahasrayogam, Ghrita prakarna 4 
 Indukantham Kashayam is a classical Ayurvedic medicine in water decoction form. This Ayurvedic medicine is mainly used in the treatment of fever and abdominal disorders. It is very beneficial in the bloating, abdominal distension, loss of appetite etc. It pacifies Vata and Pitta in body. This kashayam is actually prepared from the herbal ingredients of indukantham ghee. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Putikaranja – Holoptelea integrifolia 
 Devdaru – Cedrus deodara 
 Bilva – Aegle marmelos 
 Agnimantha – Premna mucronata 
 Shyonaka – Oroxylum indicum 
 Patala – Stereospermum suaveolens 
 Gambhari – Gmelina arborea 
 Brihati – Solanum indicum 
 Kantakari – Solanum xanthocarpum 
 Gokshura – Tribulus terrestris 
 Shalaparni – Desmodium gangeticum 
 Prishnaparni – Uraria picta 
 Pippali fruit – Piper longum 
 Pippali roots – Piper longum 
 Chavya – Piper retrofractum 
 Chitraka – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Ginger – Zingiber officinale 
 Yavakshara – Hordeum vulgare 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Coarse powder of herbal ingredients is boiled in 16 parts of water until it reduced to 4 parts. Indukantham Kashayam is prepared. 
 Dosage 
 
 Take 5 – 10 ml, before food, or on empty stomach, once or twice a day or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is advised to mix the kashayam (decoction) with equal quantity of water. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Fever 
 Abdominal bloating 
 Gaseous distention 
 Abdominal pain 
 Mild Constipation 
 Flatulence 
 Intestinal Gas 
 Bloating 
 Improves digestion 
 Chronic gastritis 
 Improves strength and immunity 
 GERD 
 Gastric & duodenal ulcer 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 There are no side effects with this medicine. 
 Over dosage may worsen the gastritis. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
